newsitem.title: PERU: TELEFONICA DEL PERU PLANS DEBT ISSUE - LIMA BOLSA.
newsitem.headline: TELEFONICA DEL PERU PLANS DEBT ISSUE - LIMA BOLSA.

text.p: Peru's Telefonica del Peru next week plans to issue 100 million soles ($37.7 million) of one-year debt paper, stock exchange officials said Tuesday.

The August 18 sale will mark the second issue in a global sale of corporate bonds through which Peru's leading telecom aims to raise $400 million by 1999. In the first issue last year, the company, which is controlled by Telefonica de Espana, sold 250 million soles worth of corporate bonds.
In a separate ongoing global issue to raise $180 million, Telefonica has sold about $110 million worth of short-term debt.
